assumptions.choice: Interpreted "when the price reaches $65.33" as the bar's closing price being >= 65.33, evaluated once per bar in next(), consistent with how the stop-loss level is defined via closing price.
assumptions.reason: Spec is silent on whether the take-profit trigger uses intrabar high or closing price; decisions in next() are naturally made on bar close.

assumptions.choice: Interpreted "closes at least 50% within the body" as the second candle's close being bounded between the body midpoint and the first candle's open (i.e., strictly within the body, not beyond it).
assumptions.reason: "Within the body" implies the close does not exceed the top of the first candle's body; otherwise the pattern would be a full engulfing rather than a piercing pattern.

assumptions.choice: The fixed $59.16 stop-loss check is evaluated before the take-profit/trailing-stop logic on every bar, including after the partial take-profit has fired.
assumptions.reason: Spec lists Stop Loss as an unconditional exit condition (#1) applying to "the position" broadly, separate from the take-profit mechanics (#2).

assumptions.choice: Sell exactly 50% of the current position size (self.position.size * 0.5) when the take-profit level is reached.
assumptions.reason: Spec states "close 50% of the open position" with no rounding rule specified; default sizer (stake=1) can still yield a valid fractional close in backtest simulation.
